name: Minamiyamashiro (Japan)
description: A black field charged at the centre with the Minamiyamashiro village emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of three curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiyamashiro, a village in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 September 1964.

features.role: Minamiyamashiro village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of three curved strokes
